name: The Ant General
pitch: You lose to any cultivator of your realm, so you take the mortal registers, insure ten thousand spears with a ward paid in stones, and let a great sect march onto a field where its arts are ordinary.

new.name: Census Seal
new.effect: Named an artifact from a mortal throne. Opens levy rows in Formulas K. Closes: no sect will hold you, and each 1,000 levy lost adds +1 heart demon, which the Nascent Soul gate reads.

new.name: Census
new.effect: Mortals may be counted in a force as levy rows.
new.second_home: a sect that arms its villages

new.name: Spear Drill
new.second_home: any militia, any sect's outer ranks

new.name: Stamped Iron
new.effect: +40 for mass-made arms that cost no thần thức and a mortal can use.

new.name: Field Array
new.effect: The leader's formation adds its L4 to every member of the force.
new.second_home: any sect's great array in a war

new.name: Given to the Ranks
new.effect: Half your L1 leaves you and counts as L4 for every member of your force.

new.name: Rotating Ranks
new.second_home: any sect that drills its reserve

new.name: Standard-Bearer's Method
new.effect: Main, Địa giai, Earth. linh_luc_pct 12, khi_huyet_pct 8. Two arts, Spear Drill, seals Drum Line.

new.name: Drum Line
new.effect: Theme formations, Earth, outer, sealed by the Standard-Bearer's Method. Size 9. Notables Given to the Ranks, Rotating Ranks; capability Field Array.

new.name: Levy
new.effect: A member row in Formulas K for mortals, who are not simulated. Combat rule 17, Formulas K. Also serves a sect arming its villages and a mortal rebellion as a world event.

new.name: War Chest
new.effect: A stock of stones prepared for a clash. An Indemnity Ward on a levy costs 1 stone a soldier a second, and falls when it empties.

questions: Formulas K has no ceiling on reserves: 2,000 Qi Refining and a mediocre Core leader beat a Nascent-led sect at R 5.44, with no new rule. Should the reserve saturate?
AC-CB-50's R 1.84 holds only where health runs out before the ward; with typical members 40 against 20 is R 2.18.
AC-CB-49's T0 of 7.77 implies D_late 22.8, not the 20.65 of a basic attack.
Formulas K does not say how a force sums net spend or pi_s, or how per-hit and per-pulse wards enter t_w.
May mortals ever be in a force?
